answers.how: The yellow car is about 86.6 px long versus 94 px for the 6 m white car: 86.6 × 6/94.
Near 1.0 s, the pedestrian moves about 19.3 px/s. Multiplying by the white-car scale, 6/94 m/px, gives 1.23 m/s.
Around 2.5 s, the yellow car moves about 65.3 px/s; 65.3 × 6/94 gives 4.17 m/s.
The yellow car is about 32 px wide; 32 × 6/94 gives 2.04 m.
The purple car is about 28.5 px wide; 28.5 × 6/94 gives 1.82 m.
The purple car is about 78 px long; 78 × 6/94 gives 4.98 m.
Near 1.0 s, the bicycle moves about 84 px/s; 84 × 6/94 gives 5.36 m/s.
The square earthen platform has a side of about 32.5 px; 32.5 × 6/94 gives 2.07 m.
The white car measures about 35.5 px wide and 94 px long; 35.5 × 6/94 gives 2.27 m.
A quadratic fit to the white car's positions gives acceleration of about 64 px/s² near 1.0 s; 64 × 6/94 gives 4.09 m/s².
The green car is about 28 px wide; 28 × 6/94 gives 1.79 m.
The green car is about 76 px long; 76 × 6/94 gives 4.85 m.
